name: Burn Rate
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Esâ Afontov: Eco-Insurrectionist, Midnight Sun's Anarch identity, which answers the first core damage each turn with a card and a sabotage 2, and the Anarch cards of Midnight Sun Stage 3. On Pay As You Go's frame after Midnight Sun Stage 2, its identity swapped, so Running Hot and Marrow are the identity's fuel: two Begemot for its two Take a Dive, a fracter that costs a core damage and grows with every one; two Ghosttongue for its two Time Bomb, another core damage that makes every event a credit cheaper; and two The Twinning for its two Friend of a Friend, charged by the credits Cyberfeeder, The Toolbox and Crash Space hold and spent on extra accesses. Pay As You Go keeps every card given up here. Midnight Sun Stage 7a: two Steelskin Scarring for its two Raindrops Cut Stone, an event that draws again when the core damage its own deck takes trashes it from the grip; Pay As You Go keeps Raindrops Cut Stone.
